title: Tamsin and the Parish
author: Marguerite Thackeray
blurb: Wren Sterling, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
